title: Holdout Corpus Validator & Ops Runbook for Embedding Quality
creator: Diego Alvarez
description: Build a reproducible holdout-corpus validation system and operational runbook to detect embedding quality regressions and cohort-level drift for the reranking endpoint. This work focuses on: (1) curating stable holdout cohorts (scoped by domain and latency-sensitive queries), (2) implementing a cohort comparator that computes offline stability indices and statistical drift signals, (3) integrating the runner with nightly batch jobs and the telemetry pipeline, and (4) producing an ops runbook + on-call alerts for triage and rollback. The goal is to catch sub-percent changes in mean reciprocal rank and embedding cosine stability across canary and production traffic, while providing clear remediation paths for SRE and ML owners.
acceptance_criteria: Holdout dataset defined: at least 5 labeled cohorts (docs + query pairs) covering search, FAQ-rerank, and short-chat rerank; stored in S3 with dataset versioning
Automated runner computes MRR, NDCG@5, embedding cosine stability index, and cohort-wise population shift scores nightly
Drift scoring thresholds and SLO breach rules configured in telemetry (PagerDuty + Slack channel) with example thresholds and rationale documented
Canary pipeline compares new model variants to pinned baseline and fails the automated rollout when degradation > 0.5% MRR or cosine stability drop > 0.015 on any high-priority cohort
Runbook includes triage checklist, responsible owners, reproducible repro commands, and a rollback procedure with exact API routes to pin model versions
Dashboard shows daily baseline vs candidate graphs, cohort histograms, and a downloadable CSV of failing examples for manual inspection
tasks: Curate holdout cohorts and label gold pairs (PM and RE team to approve cohorts)
Implement cohort comparator library (python, numpy/pandas, vectorized metrics) and unit tests
Add nightly Airflow/Orchestration job to run comparisons and emit metrics to Datadog and telemetry topics
Define alerting thresholds and wire to PagerDuty + #embed-quality Slack
Create console dashboard prototype and link to runbook
Write ops runbook and add checklists for triage/rollback, include sample curl commands to pin models via control plane API
Run load test to ensure runner scales for 100k examples in < 45 minutes and document performance profile

notes: Trade-offs: a synthetic large holdout gives better statistical power but increases cost and storage. We will start with smaller human-labeled cohorts and expand via semi-supervised pairs.
Future work: add continuous streaming drift monitors for production logs and integrate token-level latency gating for rerank to ensure quality checks do not add tail latency to live traffic.
